title: ClusteringChunkRecord
description: Schema for individual document chunk records within Knovera topic clustering datasets.

chunk_id.description: UUID string of the document chunk

document_id.description: UUID string of the parent document

workspace_id.description: UUID string of the workspace ensuring multi-tenant isolation

chunk_index.description: 0-based sequential index of the chunk in the document

page_number.description: 1-based page number if available (e.g. from PDF)

token_count.description: Estimated token count of the chunk

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical chunk text

text_preview.description: Truncated preview snippet of chunk text
